name: agent-dev-workspace
description: Agent Dev plugins for Vite, Webpack and more bundlers.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @agent-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @agent-dev/vite build && pnpm --filter @agent-dev/playground-vite dev
scripts.dev:webpack: pnpm --filter @agent-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @agent-dev/webpack build && pnpm --parallel --filter @agent-dev/core --filter @agent-dev/webpack --filter @agent-dev/playground-webpack dev
scripts.dev:webpack:once: pnpm --filter @agent-dev/core build && pnpm --filter @agent-dev/webpack build && pnpm --filter @agent-dev/playground-webpack dev
